basis: Renal insufficiency and thrombocytopenia reported in 30-79%; transient exanthem and isolated transaminase elevations do not establish additional organ damage.
Progressive brain atrophy, muscle weakness/atrophy and optic atrophy define the syndrome; respiratory insufficiency may reflect neuromuscular failure.
Localized dermal amyloid deposition causes cutaneous disease; systemic organ involvement is not characteristic.
Brain inflammation following infection, commonly mediated by a postinfectious immune response.
Defined by malignant Paget-cell infiltration of nipple/breast epidermis; direct skin involvement qualifies despite the associated breast carcinoma.
Developmental disability and skeletal anomalies define Kabuki; cardiac malformations ~40-70% and hearing loss ~50%; renal and immune involvement omitted at cap.
Acute myeloid malignancy of marrow and blood; no additional organ is consistently directly damaged in at least 30%.
Disordered proximal tibial growth causes progressive tibial bowing and genu varum.
Leptin-signalling disorder causes obesity and hypogonadism; T-cell functional/CD4 defects reported in 80-99%, autonomic dysfunction in 30-79%.
Purely psychiatric sexual disorder without intrinsic damage to a covered organ axis.
Suppurative intraocular infection directly damages ocular tissues; possible systemic sources are separate diseases.
Congenital intestinal carbohydrate-digestion enzyme deficiency causes disaccharide and starch malabsorption.
PNKP-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy with microcephaly, seizures and developmental impairment.
Malignancy of the spermatic cord, a reproductive structure outside the covered axes; no specified additional organ involvement.
Congenital hypoplastic mitral annulus causes mitral stenosis; associated cardiac malformations remain within the same axis.
Benign hamartomatous neoplasm arising within the lung.
Benign ovarian epithelial/stromal neoplasm; reproductive location without a defined endocrine disorder.
Treatment-resistant testicular germ-cell malignancy; reproductive origin and resistance do not establish damage to a covered axis.
Oral trichomonad infection principally occupies gingival/periodontal sites; pulmonary infection is rare.
Inherited combined factor V and VIII deficiency causes impaired coagulation; bleeding sites do not establish separate organ disease.
Retinal degeneration with night blindness and visual loss; CLN3 association alone does not justify neurologic or metabolic labels.
Using parent Beckwith-Wiedemann phenotype: macroglossia/abdominal-wall defects and asymmetric overgrowth; hypoglycemia ~30-50%. NSD1-specific phenotype data are sparse.
Mitochondrial myopathy causes ophthalmoplegia and ptosis; dysphagia 4/7 reflects muscle dysfunction; ataxia 2/7 and hearing loss 5-29% fall below threshold.
ABCD1 metabolic disease presents with adrenal failure; definition states neurologic disability usually (>50%) develops by middle age as the disease evolves.
Lethal skeletal dysplasia; pulmonary hypoplasia with respiratory insufficiency 80-99%, profound intellectual disability 80-99%, hearing impairment 30-79%; redundant skin lacks damage.
